description: Without signing in: only the end-of-day recap note, visible at 16:30 ET or 60 minutes after it is posted, whichever is later (until then, the previous session's recap); any date or time you give is ignored. Signed in with a free QuantGeeks account: the same. With a QuantGeeks plan: the latest read, the changes and every read of a session (bias, pivots, thesis, grades, GEX nodes), any date. QuantGeeks' regime reads for one session: throughout the trading day, a market bias, pivot levels, a thesis and the level that would invalidate it, then a graded end-of-day recap at 16:15 ET. The reads are written by Joule, QuantGeeks' AI market analyst; grades and recap numbers are computed from market data. Returns the `latest` read in full (slot time in US Eastern, bias, pivots, note, grade, GEX nodes capped at the primary, 3 major and 3 minor per book), up to 12 `changes` (bias or pivot changes, graded), the `score` (hits over graded reads, with counts; the recap's own figure is labeled as of posting) and the `recap` when posted; `detail` 'all' returns every read; `date` picks another session.

date.description: Session date, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern). Default: the most recent regular session.

detail.description: 'summary' (default): the latest read and the changes; 'all': every read of the session.

name: quantgeeks_get_regime_reads
title: Regime reads
